data.narrative:
ReOrbit, a Series A-stage space and aerospace company founded by Sethu Saveda Suvanam, has raised €45M to date. The valuation framework references a comparative universe of 5 public comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Only one valuation method proved applicable to this analysis. The Stage-Progression approach uses the €45M total raised as a proxy base and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A to subsequent-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of €90M. Peer-median analysis could not be applied due to insufficient datapoints within narrow stage and valuation-tier filters—while 14 same-sector peers exist, only 2 adjacent-stage comparables were identified, falling short of the 3-datapoint minimum required for statistical reliability. Public-comp anchoring using the Space & Aerospace sector P/S median of 26.4x across 6 public tickers cannot be executed without ReOrbit's disclosed revenue figure, which remains unavailable for private companies.

The triangulated valuation range is €76M to €103M, with a median point of €90M. Given reliance on a single method, the key uncertainty is stage-progression multiplier sensitivity. Market conditions, revenue trajectory, and customer diversification will materially affect whether ReOrbit commands a multiplier above or below the 2.0x baseline applied here.
